title: Shinonome Ena — The Year Starts With 25:00〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, this crowd's huge...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought things would've calmed down by noon or so, but I guess I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you think they'll have any fortunes left...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not sure. They apparently only have a limited supply.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If we'd come sooner, then we wouldn't have had to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I doubt that Kanade would've been able to get up so early. That also goes for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you woke up pretty early when you went to go hang out with Airi, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I only just managed to get up when my final alarm went off. Waking up like that every time sounds horrible.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The new year is upon us, so you should try to become more of a morning person! Why not make it a resolution?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm not really in a position to say anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shouldn't we head over to see if they have any fortunes left?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's see... They should be... Oh, over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, geez. There's a huge line...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, there's no point in worrying about it now, so let's be patient and wait.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The fortunes you're after are a little different compared to ones you'd normally see, right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, they're called flower fortunes, and they only have them during New Year's. They have ones made using artificial flowers, and these other ones that look like petals... Oh, I think those are the artificial flower fortunes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, they've got so many flowers lined up on those shelves! Are they made of washi paper? They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They are proper fortunes, right?
Where are the fortunes supposed to be written?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
They're apparently tied to the stems.
About as intricate as you'd expect from a limited-time special item, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And the flower petals are...
Oh, over there on the right.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They look like... Cherry blossom petals?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And they also appear to be made of washi paper.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, in addition to your fortune, a traditional Japanese waka poem is supposed to be written on each petal.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm having trouble deciding which to get.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm leaning towards the artificial flowers, since they seem more photogenic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll go with that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... This is a tough choice, but I'll also go with one of those! It should be fun to choose which type of flower to get!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll get a petal. It's less bulky.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's your criteria for choosing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, wait a second!
They seem to be running pretty low.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Is that all they have left?
Are we actually gonna be able to get any?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd be a huge downer if they ran out on us after we've waited all this time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but... That shrine maiden seems to be carrying something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That looks like... Yes, she's restocking them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now there should be plenty left by the time it's our turn!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. So, let's keep waiting patiently.
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to get some.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too! Anyway, let's open them together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A blessing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I got a blessing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you already looked? You were supposed to wait for us!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You all took so long choosing your flowers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Don't you get that it's more fun when we all open them together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I sorta wouldn't want to say it in front of everyone if I got terrible luck, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I wouldn't mind...
I'm just happy that we were able to get these fortunes together. I won't be bothered by the fortune I get.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure you wanna jinx yourself like that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm not.
Anyway, let's open them. On three.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes! A great blessing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! After saying all that?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I got a blessing just like you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mine's a small blessing.
I can't remember if this is supposed to be better or worse than just “blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Ena, I wasn't expecting you to get the best one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It just goes to show that it's important to not be greedy, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you desperately wanted one of these fortunes. That sounds pretty greedy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. Nothing you say is gonna change the fact that I drew a great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, while we're here, let's take a look at their charms. The ones they have are supposed to be really cute.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Look at her, all happy...
Then, let's go see what they have.
se_walk_women_001_4
